checked_claims: CLAIM 1 (base-case framing at (g,n,k)=(6,6,16)) -- CONFIRMED. corpus/text/SRC-0002.txt:1219 gives (6.1) H_k(hat-boundary Mbar_g,n) -> H_k(Mbar_g,n) -> W_{-k}H^BM_k(M_g,n) -> 0 for all k, and :1227-1231 gives H^BM_k(M_g,n)=0 for k<2g-2+n when n>=2 (via [4, Prop. 2.1] and H^BM_k / H^k_c duality). At (6,6): 2g-2+n=16=k, equality, so vanishing does not apply and W_{-16}H^BM_16(M_6,6) is a genuine open-stratum input. Cross-checked independently: 2g-2+n is exactly the vcd bound (vcd(M_6,6)=4g-4+n=26), so k=16 is the bottom nonvanishing Borel-Moore degree. Correct.

CLAIM 2 (published coverage stops at c(6)=5) -- CONFIRMED. SRC-0002:638-641 Table 1 lists c(6)=5; SRC-0004:2275 Lemma 10.14 states 'If n<=5, then M6,n has the CKgP and A*=R*'. n=6 is outside that range.

CLAIM 3 (M^3_6,6 settled) -- CONFIRMED. SRC-0004:1863 Lemma 9.9: 'Suppose g>=4 and n<=g+7. Then M^3_g,n has the CKgP and all classes supported on M^3_g,n are tautological.' g=6 gives g+7=13>=6. The hyperelliptic sub-case inside that proof uses Theorem 6.1 at n<=2g+6=18 (SRC-0004:1867, :1107), also satisfied. The attempt's bound citations are accurate.

CLAIM 4 (PQ_6 settled) -- CONFIRMED. SRC-0004:1282 Lemma 7.2 (CKgP of G_d,n for n<=3d-1) and :1322 Lemma 7.4 (generators, n<=3d-1, d>=4); d=5 gives 3d-1=14>=6. Faber tautologicality of the unpointed plane-quintic class plus push-pull is exactly the argument at SRC-0004:2278-2282; CKgP of PQ_n via Lemma 7.2 and proper surjectivity (Lemma 3.10, SRC-0004:767). No n-bound in Lemma 10.5 (:2094) or Proposition 8.4 (:1583) competes here.

CLAIM 5 (the n=6 evaluation failure, and its uniqueness) -- CONFIRMED on both counts. SRC-0004:2161 gives deg W_{f_i}|_C = 4g+12-4f_i and :2169 gives deg(omega_C tensor W_{f_i}|_C^vee(Gamma)) = 4f_i+n-2g-14, with :2170 f_1+f_2=g+3 and :2176 f_1 <= (g+3)/2. For g=6: f_1+f_2=9 and f_1<=4.5, so the CE stratum H^4_4,6,n is exactly F=(4,5). At n=6: f_1=4 gives 16+6-12-14=-4<0 (automatic vanishing); f_2=5 gives 20+6-12-14=0 (not automatic). At n=5 the f_2 value is -1<0, so n=6 is the first failing integer, and the rewritten bound n<=4f_1-2g+1=5 (SRC-0004:2274) is driven by the f_2 summand. Uniqueness survives audit: Lemma 9.9 (n<=13), Theorem 6.1 (n<=18), Lemmas 7.1/7.2/7.4 (n<=14), Lemma 10.5 and Proposition 8.4 (no n-bound) all hold at n=6; Lemmas 10.11 and 10.12 fail at n=6 only because they inherit the Lemma 10.6 bound, as the attempt itself states. Also verified the RED-0001 list is exactly right: solving k>=2g-2+n (n>=2) / k>=2g (n=0,1) at k=16 against Table 1 yields precisely M_3,12, M_5,8, M_6,6, M_7,4, M_8,{0,1,2}, with g=4 (n<=10<=c(4)=11) and g>=9 falling out.

CLAIM 6, CKgP HALF (CKgP of U_ok via the tower) -- CONFIRMED; I expected this to be the fatal step and it survives. My attack was that SRC-0004:2212-2213 defines U as a locus in (PE^vee)^n depending only on (E,F,Gamma), whereas Z is cut out by a condition depending on C, so U_ok is not the preimage of any open in (PE^vee)^6 and the bundle structure should collapse. It does not: for (C,Gamma) in U_ok the Lemma 10.6 proof (SRC-0004:2151-2159) still yields H^1(C,W|_C(-Gamma))=0, hence H^0(C,W|_C)->H^0(Gamma,W|_Gamma) surjective, and the H^0(PE^vee,W)->H^0(C,W|_C) step is n-independent, so the composite (10.9) is surjective at that Gamma and U_ok does map into U. Since H^4 is open in Y (:2141-2142) and Z is closed by semicontinuity, U_ok is open in Y|_U, Y|_U -> U is a vector bundle (:2220-2221), and Lemma 3.3 (:693) passes CKgP to opens. The tower claim is sound.

CLAIM 6, TAUTOLOGICAL HALF (pushforward to the image in M_6,6 minus (M^3 cup PQ)) -- NOT ESTABLISHED. Lemma 10.5 (SRC-0004:2094-2107) and Proposition 8.4 (:1583) are statements about pushforward along beta'_n, used precisely because it is PROPER (:2268-2272, 'the proper map beta''). Restricting the domain to the open U_ok = H^4 minus Z destroys properness, so beta'_*|_{U_ok} is undefined and the cited package does not apply as invoked; moreover beta'(U_ok) is constructible, not open, in M_6,6 minus (M^3 cup PQ), so Lemma 3.10 (needs proper AND surjective) cannot be applied to it either. Not fatal to the stated pure-Tate goal, since CKgP alone suffices there and Lemma 3.4 (:701, finite stratifications) plus Lemma 3.10 applied to beta' on all of H^4_4,6,6 would carry CKgP down once Z is handled -- i.e. GAP-Z-CLASSES is in fact superfluous for CONJ-0001 and bites only for A*=R*. But Claim 6 as written overstates what the published lemmas deliver.

CLAIM 7 (Z must still be handled) -- CONFIRMED but STRICTLY UNDERSTATED. Route (i) of 'What would finish', and GAP-Z-NONEMPTY, treat emptiness of Z as an open possibility. It is provably false. Set L := W_{f_2}|_C tensor omega_C^vee. From SRC-0004:2161, deg W_{f_2}|_C = 4g+12-4f_2 = 24+12-20 = 16, and deg omega_C = 2g-2 = 10, so deg L = 6 on a genus-6 curve. Riemann-Roch: h^0(L) - h^1(L) = 6-6+1 = 1, hence h^0(L) >= 1 for EVERY tetragonal cover in H^4_4,6,0. So |L| is always nonempty: there is always an effective degree-6 divisor D with O(D) iso L, and then omega_C tensor W_{f_2}|_C^vee(D) iso O_C, i.e. h^0 = 1 != 0. Wherever such D is reduced (h^0(L)>=2, or the unique member of |L| reduced -- the generic behaviour), (C,D) lies in Z. Hence Z is nonempty, DOMINATES the space of unmarked tetragonal genus-6 covers, and has codimension at most 6 (expected exactly 6) in H^4_4,6,6. Route (i) is closed, and route (ii) must handle a locus surjecting onto all of tetragonal genus-6 moduli rather than a small exceptional set. GAP-Z-NONEMPTY should be restated as a refutation. GAP-Z-GEOMETRY, GAP-Z-CKGP and GAP-EXCISION-GLUE remain genuinely open and are correctly flagged.

CLAIM 8 (even full CKgP of M_6,6 discharges only this node) -- CONFIRMED. SRC-0002:581-591 Lemma 4.3 is uniform in k and yields only surjectivity of cl onto W_kH^k, hence 'pure Hodge-Tate', not A*=R*; GAP-A-EQUALS-R correctly records this, while SRC-0002's own proof of Theorem 1.5(3) (:1234) needs CKgP AND A*=R* for the tautological conclusion. The eight remaining RED-0001 nodes are correctly left open.

strongest_attack: STRONGEST ATTACK -- Borel-Moore homological degree silently reused as a cohomological degree, with the Tate twist advertised but never performed; SURVIVES, the claim is false as written. The attempt asserts that 'Poincare duality identifies the dual pure-weight problem with controlling W_16 H^{16}(M_6,6) (with explicit Tate twist bookkeeping)', and repeats it in GAP-PURE-WEIGHT-16 as 'W_16 H^{16}(M_6,6) (equivalently W_{-16}H^BM_16(M_6,6) up to duality/Tate twist)'. Compute it. M_6,6 is smooth of complex dimension d = 3g-3+n = 15+6 = 21, so H^BM_k(M_6,6) iso H^{2d-k}(M_6,6) tensor Q(d) = H^{42-k}(M_6,6)(21). At k=16 the duality partner is COHOMOLOGICAL DEGREE 26, not 16, and the correct identification is W_{-16}H^BM_16(M_6,6) iso W_26 H^{26}(M_6,6) tensor Q(21). The stated degree is off by 10 and the twist Q(21) is omitted entirely. Sanity check that 26 is right: vcd(M_6,6) = 4g-4+n = 26, so H^{26} is the top nonvanishing cohomological degree, mirroring k=16 being the bottom nonvanishing Borel-Moore degree -- both extremal, whereas W_16 H^{16}(M_6,6) sits in the middle of the range and is a different object. The advertised bookkeeping cannot be repaired at degree 16: by the proof of SRC-0002 Lemma 4.3 (corpus/text/SRC-0002.txt:616-625), the only surviving correspondence terms have k = 2d - 2*ell, so W_kH^k is hit by cycles of codimension d - ell = k/2; at k=26, d=21 that is A^{13}(M_6,6), giving Tate type Q(-13), and Q(-13) tensor Q(21) = Q(8), of weight -16 as required. Dualizing via H^{16}(Mbar;Q) iso H_16(Mbar;Q)^vee returns Q(-8) in H^{16}(Mbar_6,6), matching CONJ-0001. Run the same bookkeeping through the attempt's degree 16 and it yields Q(-8) tensor Q(21), of weight -58, not the weight -16 the base-case input must have -- the numbers do not close on the attempt's indexing. The error is aggravated by SRC-0002:79-80, which the attempt never applies: CLP explicitly set H_k(Mbar_g,n) := H^{2d_{g,n}-k}(Mbar_g,n), so the object the degree-16 induction actually needs at this node is H^{26}(Mbar_6,6) iso sum Q(-13), and the attempt's non-claim about 'H^{16}(Mbar_6,6;Q) a sum of Q(-8)' names only the weaker Hard-Lefschetz shadow of it. MITIGATION, in fairness: this damages the attempt's stated translation, not its strategy, because SRC-0002 Lemma 4.3 and Proposition 4.5 are uniform in k, so CKgP of M_6,6 would still deliver the correct degree-26 group; and SRC-0002 is itself terse at the same junction (:1234-1236 invokes Proposition 4.5 for W_{-k}H^BM_k without spelling out the index). RUNNER-UP ATTACK, also surviving and arguably more damaging to the repair itself: route (i), that Z might be empty, is refuted outright by Riemann-Roch. deg(W_{f_2}|_C tensor omega_C^vee) = (4g+12-4f_2) - (2g-2) = 16 - 10 = 6 on a genus-6 curve, so chi = 6-6+1 = 1 and h^0 >= 1 for every cover in H^4_4,6,0; hence Z is nonempty, dominates the unmarked tetragonal locus, and has codimension at most 6 -- GAP-Z-NONEMPTY is not an open possibility but a closed door, and route (ii) must confront a locus surjecting onto all of tetragonal genus-6 moduli. THIRD FINDING: Claim 6's tautological half invokes Lemma 10.5 / Proposition 8.4 pushforward along beta' restricted to the open U_ok, which is not proper, so that pushforward is undefined and beta'(U_ok) is constructible rather than open; recoverable, since CKgP alone suffices for the pure-Tate target and would descend via Lemma 3.4 plus Lemma 3.10 applied to beta' on all of H^4_4,6,6 once Z is handled. ATTACKS THAT FAILED: the tower U_ok subset Y|_U -> U was my primary candidate for collapse, on the ground that U lives in (PE^vee)^n while Z depends on C, but Lemma 10.6's proof still places the image of U_ok inside U and Lemma 3.3 passes CKgP to opens, so CKgP of U_ok holds. No coarse-space, integral-coefficient, Kunneth/Gysin-shift, spectral-sequence, automorphism-coinvariant, semisimplification, conditional-prediction, tautological-upgrade, or omitted-stable-pair defect was found; the RED-0001 finite list reproduces exactly on independent re-derivation. NET VERDICT: incomplete. The attempt is unusually candid and its central geometric identification of the n=6 obstruction is correct and correctly located, but it contains one false load-bearing duality claim, one gap marker that should be a refutation, and one misapplied pushforward, and it does not close RED-0001 at (6,6).
